core_package_dependency_policy: No external model runtime dependency in the core package; exact model implementations are injected behind typed adapters.

B1.normalization: L2 normalize document and query vectors in the retrieval core
B1.similarity: dot product over normalized vectors, equivalent to cosine

B2.score_sort: descending RRF score then document_id ascending

B3.tail_policy: Ranks 21-50 retain B2 order and are appended after the reranked head.

evaluation.recall_inapplicable_rule: Queries with no eligible relevance >=2 return null per-query recall and are excluded from the recall macro-average.
evaluation.bootstrap_percentile_interpolation: linear interpolation at 0.025 and 0.975 over sorted replicate means

latency.measurement_execution: deferred to R3.2 because R3.1 performs no frozen-query retrieval

execution.concrete_model_runtime_binding: R3.2 execution environment must load the protocol-pinned revisions; result-motivated model substitution is prohibited.
